title: 高层建筑判定

derive.H_top: max(IfcBuildingStorey.Elevation) 中有人员长期停留的最高楼层楼面标高 − 室外地面标高（取建筑一侧最不利值）

requirement: 该建筑属于高层建筑，适用高层建筑规定；高度 ≤ 60 m 时须至少两部疏散楼梯，分设于两个防火分区、相对布置，通行宽度 ≥ 1.25 m
else: 不属于高层建筑，不触发本规则

basis.quote: High-rise buildings are those intended for long-term human occupation whose upper-most floor on one side of the building is more than 22 m above ground level.
High-rise buildings up to 60 m high: at least two emergency stairs must be available, which must be located opposite in two separate fire compartments. Their walking width must be at least 1.25 m.

notes: “最高楼层”按楼面标高而非屋顶高度；IFC 里没有“有人员停留”的属性，只能靠楼层下是否有 IfcSpace 推断。

title: 办公楼室内净高

derive.h_clear: Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.Height（若无则 楼层高 − 楼板厚 − 吊顶/架空地板）

requirement: h_clear ≥ 2.75 m；以坐姿工作为主的房间可减 0.25 m 但 ≥ 2.50 m；走廊和卫生间可为 2.30 m

basis.quote: Ceiling height 2.75 m according to Vst regulation (enables the later installation of raised floor and deeper suspended ceilings).
For predominantly sedentary activities, the reduction of the ceiling height by 25 cm is possible, but min. 2.50 m clear.
Corridors and sanitary facilities are permitted to be 2.30 m high (this can be exploited for installation runs).

ifc_needed: IfcBuilding 用途（模型里没有，取自 model_card）
notes: 三个分支由房间功能决定；同一条知识转成了 3 个 (context → 值) 对。

title: 踏步比与步距公式
requirement: 59 cm ≤ 2r + t ≤ 65 cm；最省力为坡度 30°、r/t = 17/29

basis.quote: In order to determine a suitable pitch with the lowest energy requirement, this formula applies: 2 r + t = 59–65 cm.
the best use of 'climbing effort' is at a stair pitch of 30° and a ratio of riser (r) to tread (t) of 17/29.

notes: 公式只约束 2r+t，不约束 r 本身；r=20、t=20 也满足公式但坡度 45°，所以要配合 K11 的 17/28 一起看。

title: 必要楼梯的梯段步数与休息平台

derive.has_landing: IfcStair 的分解中是否含平台（IfcSlab LANDING）或多于一个 IfcStairFlight

requirement: 须设休息平台（must）；每段 3 ≤ n_riser ≤ 18（18 为 should）；平台宽 ≥ 梯段宽

basis.quote: Stairs with landings are required in legally essential stairways with a storey height of \( \geq 2.75 \) m.
Length of runs on legally essential stairs is \( \geq 3 \) steps up to \( \leq 18 \) steps
The 18-step rule is a 'should' regulation.
Landing width \( \geq \) stair width.

notes: “必要楼梯”在 IFC 里没有属性；办公楼里连接各层且是唯一/主要竖向通道的楼梯按必要楼梯处理。

title: 必要楼梯的宽度与踏步比

derive.w: 梯段可用宽度（Qto_StairFlightBaseQuantities.Width，缺失时取几何包围盒短边）

basis.quote: legally essential stairs 1.00 m, 17/28

notes: K11 原表是住宅建筑的表，办公楼按同一数值（最严格的 1.00 m）处理；高层另加严到 1.25 m（见 R01）。扶手条款（K17）按评审意见去掉。

title: 护栏高度按坠落高度分档

derive.drop: 护栏所在楼面标高 − 下方可能坠落到的楼面标高

requirement: drop < 12 m → h ≥ 0.90 m；drop > 12 m → h ≥ 1.10 m；工作场所且 drop < 12 m → h ≥ 1.00 m

basis.quote: drop <12 m, h = 0.90 m
drop >12 m, h = 1.10 m

ifc_needed: IfcRailing 的楼层与下方空间（判断坠落高度）
notes: 典型的“同一构件、不同 context 取不同值”的规则：条件变量 drop 不在构件自身上，而来自它所在楼层与周围空间。

title: 门的净高与无障碍净宽

derive.h_clear: 净开启高度（Qto_DoorBaseQuantities.Height 或 OverallHeight 减门框）
derive.w_clear: 净通行宽度（OverallWidth 减门框与门扇厚度）

requirement: 内门 h_clear ≥ 2.10 m；无障碍公共建筑门 w_clear ≥ 0.90 m；至少一个入口净宽 ≥ 0.90 m 且无台阶

basis.quote:
clear opening height of internal doors
minimum	210 cm
Clear passage width of doors \( \geq 0.90 \) m
must be accessible through an entrance with a clear opening width of at least 0.90 m without steps.

notes: IFC 的 OverallWidth 是洞口/名义尺寸，净宽通常再小 5–10 cm，判定时应注明是按名义尺寸还是净尺寸。

title: 混凝土外墙必须附加保温层

match.wall.core_material: 混凝土（IfcMaterial.Category = 'Beton' 或名称含 StB/Beton）

derive.has_insulation: IfcMaterialLayerSet / IfcMaterialConstituentSet 中含保温材料（Category='Dämmung' 或名称含 Wärmedämmung/insulation）

requirement: has_insulation = True：外保温系统，或带夹心保温（可背通风）的多叶构造

basis.quote: Solid concrete walls can be used as external walls only with an additional thermal insulation layer. This can be as an external thermal insulation system → ① or as a multi-leaf construction (analogous to p. 75) with core insulation and possibly back-ventilation.

notes: Revit 导出常用 IfcMaterialConstituentSet 而不是 LayerSet，层厚丢失；只能判断“有没有保温”，判断不了厚度。

title: 每工位面积指标

derive.n_ws: 房间内 IfcFurniture 中办公桌（desk）数量

requirement: 直接工位面积 11–15 m²/工位（均值 13）；加洽谈/存放 1.5–4.2、交通 2.2–6.0 后每工位总需求 23–45 m²（整栋楼口径）

basis.quote: Workstation | Immediate workstation | 11–15 | 13 | 15.5
Traffic area | 2.2–6.0 | 4.5
The total space requirement per workstation varies between 23 and 45 m^2, depending on organisational and status requirements.

ifc_needed: IfcFurniture 与 IfcSpace 的空间包含关系（模型没有 IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure 到 Space，需按几何判断）
notes: 11–15 是房间级口径，23–45 是整栋楼（含交通、附属）口径，两个 context 不能混用。

title: 自然采光进深

derive.d: 从采光面（窗所在的外墙 / 幕墙）起，垂直量到对面墙的进深
derive.daylight_face: 房间哪一面是采光面：有 IfcWindow 开向它的外墙，或贴着幕墙的那一面

derive.d: 房间垂直于采光外墙方向的进深

requirement: 工作房间从采光面起的进深不宜超过约 7 m；更深的部分无法靠天光，只能人工照明。中廊式办公楼整体进深通常 12–13 m（两侧房间各 ≈ 5–6 m + 走廊）

basis.quote: Daylight can mostly be exploited into a room depth of about 7.00 m.
The usual depth of buildings with central corridors is 12–13 m.

ifc_needed: IfcRelSpaceBoundary 或几何判断哪面墙是外墙/幕墙
notes: 这不是照明规则，是进深规则：7 m 是天光够得着的深度。进深按采光面的法线方向量，不是房间短边。没有任何采光面的内部房间按“无法靠天光”判。

title: 工作场所厕所配置

derive.wc_on_storey: 该层含 IfcSanitaryTerminal(WC) 的 IfcSpace

requirement: 分设男女厕所、仅供员工使用；每个工位到厕所 ≤ 100 m 或至多一层楼高；厕所由带洗手盆的前室（n_basin ≥ n_wc/5）和完全分隔的 WC 间组成；参考比例每 50–80 工位一个厕所单元

basis.quote: If there are more than five employees, separate toilets must be provided for women and men and these should be available exclusively to employees.
These are to be provided at a distance from each workstation of not more than 100 m or, at the farthest, one storey height (if no escalator is available).

Toilet facilities consist of a lobby with washbasins (at least one washbasin per five WCs) and a completely separate room with at least one WC (unless the facilities contain only one toilet and have no direct access to a work, social, changing, wash or sanitary room).
A good ratio is one toilet unit per 50–80 workstations. Space requirement ~0.6–0.8 m² per workstation.

ifc_needed: 男女之分（IFC 无此属性）
notes: “男/女”在 IFC 中没有标准属性，只能从房间名或家具推断，否则记为 unknown。

title: 会议区每座面积

derive.n_seat: 房间内会议桌椅组合的座位数（IfcFurniture 名称/类型）

requirement: a_seat ≈ 2.5 m²/座（不含附属空间）；储藏与备餐等附属空间约为会议面积的 1/3

basis.quote: A conference area requires about 2.5 m^2 per seat (without subsidiary areas).
store rooms and a pantry for catering (these subsidiary rooms require about 1/3 of the conference area)

ifc_needed: IfcFurniture（座位数常只在族名里，如 '... - 8 Stühle'）
